name: AXFRA House — Master Exterior
mood: luxury residential, contemporary, welcoming, mountain retreat
style: Alarsi editorial style, ultra photorealistic architectural photography, cinematic natural lighting, luxury residential aesthetic, hyper-detailed materials, realistic reflections, accurate water physics, no plastic look, masterpiece, best quality

environment_block.purpose: Permanent residential exterior set for recurring scenes involving the eight AXFRA identities and Conde Alarsi.

location.setting: Spacious private property in the Andean foothills, surrounded by native central Chilean mountain vegetation.
location.terrain: Gently sloping land with a broad level platform supporting the house, pool and vehicle areas.
location.background: A continuous rugged Andean mountain ridge rises behind the house. Dry rocky slopes, muted brown and gray terrain, sparse vegetation and small patches of snow on the highest distant peaks.
location.landscape_rule: Preserve the same mountain silhouette and its alignment behind the house across all scenes.

spatial_reference.reference_view: Standing at the front entrance of the property, looking toward the main facade.
spatial_reference.left: Left side of the image in the reference view.
spatial_reference.right: Right side of the image in the reference view.
spatial_reference.front: The garden and pool side facing the property entrance.
spatial_reference.rear: The mountain-facing side behind the house.
spatial_reference.rule: These directions describe permanent world positions. Camera changes must not mirror or rearrange the property.

architecture.roof: Flat roofs with clean horizontal parapets.
architecture.composition: Three connected rectangular volumes: a central double-height entrance, a left social wing and a right residential wing.

materials.secondary: Natural gray stone cladding on the central entrance volume
materials.accent: Warm timber soffits and recessed wall panels
materials.terrace_railings: Clear glass with minimal dark fittings

architecture.central_volume: A recessed double-height glazed entrance framed by natural gray stone, with a large warm timber pivot door.
architecture.left_wing: Ground-floor living room, dining room and kitchen behind continuous glazing, opening directly onto the front pool terrace. Upper-floor bedrooms open onto a continuous terrace.
architecture.right_wing: Private residential rooms distributed across both floors, with an attached music rehearsal room at the far right of the ground floor.
architecture.residential_capacity: Nine individual bedroom suites distributed across both wings and both floors.
architecture.signature_feature: A large warm white rectangular architectural frame surrounds the entire upper terrace of the left wing. This frame is the main visual identifier of AXFRA House.
architecture.branding: One small matte black AXFRA wordmark beside the main entrance, in Helvetica Bold, occupying approximately 3 percent of the visible central entrance wall.

site_layout.house: Rear central portion of the developed platform, with the main facade facing the front garden.

pool.position: In front of the left social wing.
pool.orientation: Long edge parallel to the main facade.
pool.finish: Pale blue interior, clear turquoise water and light natural stone coping.
pool.terrace: Wide light stone terrace with four neutral beige sun loungers arranged in two pairs.
pool.rule: Keep the pool entirely to the left of the central entrance axis. Never place it across the entrance path.

site_layout.pedestrian_access: A straight light stone walkway leads from the front garden to the central entrance, passing along the right edge of the pool terrace.

car_parking.position: To the right of the central entrance, directly in front of the right wing.
car_parking.surface: Large light gray concrete paving slabs
car_parking.cover: Flat-roofed carport with slim matte black columns.

tour_bus_bay.position: At the far right boundary of the property, beyond the two-car parking area.
tour_bus_bay.surface: Dedicated paved bay connected to a wide driveway.
tour_bus_bay.orientation: Bus parked with its long side visible from the front reference view.
tour_bus_bay.clearance: Enough space for a full-size touring coach to enter and maneuver.
tour_bus_bay.rule: The bus bay is separate from the two car spaces and does not obstruct the house entrance.

site_layout.garden: Restrained landscaping with native grasses, low shrubs, scattered quillay trees and small areas of maintained lawn. Preserve an open view of the facade and mountains.
site_layout.boundary: Low natural stone perimeter walls and a simple matte black vehicle gate.

vehicles.roof: Black convertible soft top, folded down
vehicles.position: Left space of the two-car carport
vehicles.orientation: Front of the car facing toward the property entrance

vehicles.details: Black wheel arches, rugged tires and rear-mounted spare wheel
vehicles.position: Right space of the two-car carport
vehicles.orientation: Front of the vehicle facing toward the property entrance

vehicles.type: Full-size luxury rock band touring coach
vehicles.details: Long modern coach body, dark tinted windows and polished metal wheels
vehicles.branding: Large white AXFRA lettering centered on the visible side, clean Helvetica Bold typography, correctly spelled.
vehicles.position: Dedicated bus bay at the far right boundary of the property

animals.appearance: Long sable and white coat, full white chest ruff, white paws and an elongated muzzle.
animals.reference_position: Resting on the lawn beside the pool terrace, away from the water.

animals.appearance: Silver-gray tabby coat with dark stripes, white chest and green eyes.
animals.reference_position: Sitting beside the central entrance on the dry stone walkway.

camera_and_style_block.camera_position: Front of the property, slightly left of the central entrance axis, at approximately 3 meters above ground.
camera_and_style_block.view: Wide front three-quarter view showing the complete mansion, front pool, both parked cars and the tour bus bay.
camera_and_style_block.perspective: Corrected vertical lines, natural building proportions, no fisheye distortion.
camera_and_style_block.framing: House as the main subject, pool in the foreground, vehicle areas on the right and mountains clearly visible behind the roofline.
camera_and_style_block.focus: Deep depth of field with detailed architecture and readable spatial relationships.

lighting_block.weather: Clear sky with a few thin high clouds
lighting_block.sun_position: Camera-left, illuminating the front facade at an angle
lighting_block.quality: Warm natural sunlight with soft, physically consistent shadows
lighting_block.interior_lighting: Subtle warm interior lights visible through the glazing
lighting_block.pool_reflections: Realistic reflections of the facade and sky with gentle water ripples

locked_elements: Upper rectangular frame on the left wing
scene_variables: Vehicle presence within their assigned areas
continuity_block.reference_rule: When an approved reference image is supplied, preserve its architecture, proportions, spatial layout and mountain silhouette. Describe camera changes as movement around the same property.

constraints_block.people: No people in this initial exterior reference image.
constraints_block.architecture: Exactly two floors. Preserve the specified facade and layout. No additional wings, towers, pitched roofs or duplicate buildings.
constraints_block.vehicles: Exactly one red Mustang convertible, one red Jeep Wrangler and one black AXFRA touring bus in their assigned areas.
constraints_block.animals: Exactly one Collie and one cat.
constraints_block.pool: Exactly one rectangular pool. No additional pools or fountains.
constraints_block.landscape: Central Chilean Andean foothills. No tropical vegetation, beach, ocean or dense alpine forest.
constraints_block.text: Only the specified AXFRA wordmarks. No additional signage, captions or watermarks.
